title: Koutoubia Mosque
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Koutoubia mosque exterior:original mapped compound with two unfilled courts,parallel brown nave roofs,transverse raised bays,ochre walls/selected horseshoe doors,pale inner arcade,and tall square minaret with different facade fields,green tile bands,pointed parapet crest,smaller lantern,ribbed ochre cap and globe finial. Seven existing shared256² graphs,seven merged roles,four authored browser levels. Exact roof details,carvings,room plans,current condition and walking remain approximate or unverified.
